# Museum multispectral scan ingestion

This workspace selects payload files, starts transfers, records queue and
progress history, and paints progress for its open panel. Runtime: CPython 3.8.10.
Dependencies: Python standard library. See src for the session/component entry API.

Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without
opening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit.
The source is shared by attempts and visits for that file. start may emit cached
packets synchronously; decoding yields a full frame, immediately or later.
Decode completion order can differ from packet arrival order.

recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel.
Queue records, notices, cancellation, retry, navigation, and cleanup retain
their existing behavior. Queue records are {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}
unless a separate authorization adds byteCount from file.size.

One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle.

The same source service also has a diagnostic consumer, Telemetry/
collectProgressTelemetry, whose existing live delta observations are separate
from the panel. Keep its existing behavior during this maintenance.
Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;
that callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is
inert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred.

Files have stable object identity and immutable id/size during these commands.
A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset.
A decode result resolves once; rejected decode and physical transfer completion
are outside this embedding's model. Each workspace has its own lifetime.

Environment.call/bind provides a synchronous source embedding: listen(file
 token, callback token) returns a subscription, start can invoke it before
returning, and unlisten may reenter navigation. decode(file token, packet,
completion token) returns {deferred:false,frame} or {deferred:true}. Deferred
completion invokes the bound native closure on an explicit later host turn.
Transport receives a physical cancellation observer corresponding to the
native attempt state; cancel is idempotent. The wire embedding interns file
objects and forwards source/sink calls. Go uses context cancellation; the other
native ports use object flags. No native DOM/Promise runtime is claimed.

{"report":"1. 可确认的 Contract

传输面板应收到 warm progress source 在启动时同步发出的初始进度；后续普通流式进度仍应显示。完整进度帧即使按不同于包到达的顺序完成解码，也不得让较旧的帧把当前显示回滚。修复须保留公开的传输、重试、导航、清理、审计、队列记录行为，诊断遥测及后续使用。

2. 每条的条件、效果、来源及依据

- 初始进度：当 `start` 同步发出缓存包时，当前打开的访问应能显示该包解码得到的帧，而不必等下一包。用户任务直接要求恢复；[README.md](/workspace/README.md:7) 确认同步发包及同步或延迟解码。当前 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:12) 先 `start` 后 `listen`，说明初始包可能错过；这是实现事实，不是期望顺序的规范。
- 显示顺序：同一次活动的多个包产生完整帧且解码乱序时，较旧包的帧不得覆盖较新包已显示的帧。用户任务直接要求；[README.md](/workspace/README.md:7) 确认解码完成顺序可变，[README.md](/workspace/README.md:30) 确认完整帧替换显示状态、loaded 可下降或重置。因此不能仅凭 loaded 数值判定新旧。当前 `active()` 在收包时取得 `order`，但会话传入固定的 `lambda:0`，`view` 也未使用该值；见 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:5) 与 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:35)。
- 审计与遥测：进度审计应继续追加传输历史；诊断消费者应继续观察其原有的实时增量。来源是用户任务及 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:13)、[README.md](/workspace/README.md:24)。当前每个解码完成帧先调用 `audit` 再调用 `view`；Telemetry 独立监听并调用 `recordDelta`，见 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:7) 与 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:73)。显示防回滚不能未经依据地改写审计或诊断语义。
- 访问与尝试身份：选文件建立新 visit；retry 在同一 visit 内替换物理 attempt；再次选择同一文件对象建立新 visit，来源为 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:7)。当前队列记录含 fileId、attemptId、visitId、kind；进度审计捕获提交时的 fileId 和 attemptId；显示在回调时检查 visit 是否仍为当前，见 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:30)。用户任务及 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:13) 要求保留队列、重试、导航与清理行为。队列字段不得擅加 byteCount，除非另有授权，见 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:15)。
- 生命周期：`select`、`retry`、`hide`、`dispose` 会经由 `release` 或任务列表调用 attempt 的 `cancel`；取消会移除监听并通知物理传输，见 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:24) 与 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:40)。`unlisten` 可以同步重入导航；一次 `start` 可同步发多个包，`showProgress` 也可在 `start` 返回、调用者取得清理句柄前切换或隐藏 visit，见 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:17)、[README.md](/workspace/README.md:27)。所以该启动窗口内，回调、句柄赋值及取消的先后次序都须纳入验证。
- 等待间隙与后续使用：每包的延迟解码会安排一次后续完成回调；当前源码未显示会话主动安排其他后续工作。回调捕获旧 visit、attempt 与文件身份；审计使用捕获身份，显示读取当时共享的 `self.visit`。若旧解码在切换后才完成，仍可能调用审计；仅当旧 visit 再次成为当前时才会通过现有显示检查。相同文件对象可用于新 visit，不能用文件身份代替访问身份。依据为 [workflow.py](/workspace/src/workflow.py:30) 和 [README.md](/workspace/README.md:7)、[README.md](/workspace/README.md:35)。

3. 不能确认的候选要求

- 延迟解码在取消、隐藏或卸载之后是否必须停止审计、停止回调或由宿主撤销：文档仅说明监听移除、物理取消及延迟完成机制，未规定已在途解码的撤销保证或产品政策。
- 进度顺序应跨 retry、跨 visit 还是仅在某一面板显示活动内重置，以及队列通知与初始显示的精确先后政策：任务要求保留行为，但未给出完整排序规则。当前 `showQueued` 在 enqueue 返回后调用；不能仅据此推出唯一规范。
- 某个字段必须独自表示整个活动，或必须采用特定缓冲、取消、隔离方案：源码标识符与当前写法不足以支持这些要求。

4. 建议验证范围

只读分析尚未运行候选程序。建议验证：同步首包及多包、立即与乱序延迟解码、loaded 合法下降、后续包继续显示；逐项核对审计、`recordDelta`、队列字段及传输取消。覆盖请求执行中、请求结束后的延迟回调间隙、retry、同文件再次选择、隐藏、卸载和 `unlisten` 同步重入，检查每个可见效果归属的 visit 与 attempt。此类验证仍不能单独确定文档未规定的宿主撤销保证或产品政策。"}
